page.layout: One scanned image of a closed book binding: dark leather cover with gold tooled rules on the front board and spine. No printed page visible. A torn paper label is attached at the upper left of the spine and a small white paper label at the lower left edge.
page.notes: Book cover only (front board and spine in leather binding), not a printed page. The torn paper label on the spine and the small white label at lower left are not printed text on this page and are not transcribed. No text is legible on the cover.
